documents.subject: Payroll record and settlement review
documents.body:
Hello Casey Team05 and Taylor Team06,

For the 2025-06-30 payroll record under PAY-006, the packet lists gross payroll of $438,000.00, withholding of $87,600.00, employer amounts of $35,040.00, and net payroll of $350,400.00. Please confirm whether any explanation is available for the recorded figures or whether additional documentation is expected. Under the settlement policy, only confirmed external movements are settled; proposals are not settlements. No payment or additional approval is established here.

Regards,
Meridian Ledger Labs, Inc.

documents.subject: PAY-006 clarification
documents.body:
Casey Team05: I’m reviewing PAY-006 dated 2025-06-30. The packet provides gross, withholding, employer, and net figures, but it does not explain the underlying movement or identify any confirmed external settlement.

documents.subject: Settlement policy excerpt
documents.body: “Only confirmed external movements are settled; proposals are not settlements.” This excerpt applies to the settlement handling described for MERIDIAN-001. The available packet identifies PAY-006 and provides payroll figures dated 2025-06-30, but it does not state that any external movement has been confirmed. It also does not establish additional approval, payment, commercial terms, or a resolved settlement outcome. Any interpretation beyond the stated policy requires supporting information or clarification from the responsible finance or people operations contact.
